746|ar.rationale: The caller shows a numeric peerCode after this label. رمز is the standard UI word for a numeric code; شفرة can also mean cipher. The colon is preserved.

750|es.target: Contrae todos los paneles de mensajes abiertos en el dock de mensajes.
750|es.rationale: The caller collapses message panels into a UI dock. Muelle means a physical pier/dock and is misleading in this interface; the borrowed UI term dock identifies the destination.

750|hi.target: सभी खुले संदेश पैनलों को संदेश डॉक में समेटें।
750|hi.rationale: गोदी means a lap or landing-stage and is a false-friend rendering of the UI dock. This target names the message dock and retains the collapse action.

753|ar.target: صغّر المشغّل إلى شريط صغير أعلى تذييل الصفحة.
753|ar.rationale: The current target translates “drawer bar” literally. The caller renders a compact player bar above the page footer; this target states that resulting layout.

753|de.target: Klappen Sie den Player in eine kleine Leiste über der Fußzeile ein.
753|de.rationale: Schubladenleiste is a literal furniture drawer. The caller collapses the player to a small horizontal bar above the footer.

753|es.target: Contrae el reproductor en una barra pequeña sobre el pie de página.
753|es.rationale: Barra de cajón is a literal furniture drawer. The caller collapses the player to a small horizontal bar above the footer.

755|es.target: Contrae este panel para guardarlo en el dock de mensajes.
755|es.rationale: The caller puts a collapsed panel in the shared message dock. The current “panel de mensajes” omits that destination; this candidate names the dock.

756|ar.rationale: The control exits visualizer fullscreen and returns the audio visualization to the player bar. مُحلّل الصوت means audio analyzer, a different function; عارض الصوت names the display being collapsed.

762|es.target: Elementos de la colección no disponibles
762|es.rationale: Collections.jsx reports that loading items in a user-created collection failed. Artículos de colección usually means collectible items; this target describes the collection’s elements.

762|fr.rationale: Collections.jsx reports that loading items in a user-created collection failed. Objets de collection suggests collectible objects; this target describes elements belonging to the collection.

762|pt-BR.rationale: Collections.jsx reports that loading items in a user-created collection failed. Adding da clarifies that the items belong to this collection, rather than being collectibles.
